title: Synchrony Financial presents at KBW Fintech Ecosystem Conference 2026
digest:
Brian Wenzel of Synchrony Financial presented at the 2026 KBW Fintech Ecosystem Conference on November 11, which attracted 209 global companies and investors to discuss future trends in financial services.

The event highlighted fintech integration as a strategic focus, though specific initiatives or outcomes were not disclosed in the report.
